points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFoo>('fooService')` (`instantiation.ts:109`). By convention the const and the interface share the name, as in `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>(...)`.
Use constructor injection. Put the service parameters last, after any non-service arguments, and decorate each one: `constructor(arg: string, @IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService)`.

When a class is created with `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, 'arg')`, the container reads that metadata and supplies the services, with your static arguments first. ... Editor panes, view containers and contributions are registered this way and instantiated by the framework.
